name: Omenpaths
description: Omenpaths are stable pathways between planes that opened across the Multiverse after the New Phyrexian Invasion, letting people without a spark travel between worlds.

bio.text: Elesh Norn generated energy pathways along the branches of the World Tree, and millions of Phyrexians poured through omenpaths when the invasion began.

bio.text: After the invasion and the Desparkening, omenpaths opened across the Multiverse while desparked planeswalkers stayed trapped on their planes.

bio.text: Niv-Mizzet saw the omenpath patterns as a threat and planned to make Ravnica a locus of the Multiverse, and he calls them his responsibility as Living Guildpact because they could be used to smuggle goods.

citations.text: "Multiverse", section "Nexus of the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, Omenpaths begin to open between planes, enabling non-Planeswalkers to travel.
timeline.quote: portals known as Omenpaths began to open between planes

citation.text: "Multiverse", section "Planes of existence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet recognizes the Omenpath patterns as a threat and devises a plan to position Ravnica as a locus of the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet recognized their patterns as a significant threat to his plane

citation.text: "Multiverse", section "Nexus of the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Invasion, stable Omenpaths appear around Ghirapur, making it poised to be a center of multiversal trade.
timeline.quote: After the Invasion, a wealth of stable Omenpaths appeared in and around Ghirapur.

citation.text: "Ghirapur", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Strixhaven welcomes its first exoplanar students in 4563 AR and charts nearby Omenpaths by 4564 AR.
timeline.quote: The inaugural class of exoplanar students was welcomed at Strixhaven in 4563 AR

citation.text: "Arcavios", section "Omenpaths". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Omenpaths open in 4562 AR and the inaugural class of off-plane students arrives the next year with new professors.
timeline.quote: After the opening of the Omenpaths in 4562 AR , the inaugural class of off-plane students was welcomed the following year

citation.text: "Strixhaven", section "The University". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With the strike force's failure, Elesh Norn and the compleated planeswalkers begin the invasion and millions of Phyrexians pour through the omenpaths.
timeline.quote: Millions of Phyrexians immediately entered the omenpaths and traveled to new planes

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The multiverse is scarred by the Invasion and the Desparking, leaving Omenpaths between planes.
timeline.quote: Along with the Desparking, causing many of the multiverse's planeswalkers to lose their sparks, the Invasion left behind Omenpaths between planes.

citation.text: "Plane", section "The Omenpath Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Proft explains that rifts called Omenpaths opened across the planes after the invasion, and Niv-Mizzet says they are natural to Kaldheim.
timeline.quote: A phenomenon natural to the plane of Kaldheim.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet explains the Omenpaths are his responsibility as Living Guildpact, as they could be used to exploit security gaps or smuggle goods.
timeline.quote: As Living Guildpact, they're my responsibility.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

timeline.summary: Yuma runs off down the Omenpaths, abandoning his friends and taking the money.
timeline.quote: Just ran off down the Omenpaths, not knowing where I was going.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | No Tells" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The opening of the Omenpaths awakens the plane's wild magic, which settlers dub thunder.
timeline.quote: The opening of the Omenpaths awoke the wild magic of Thunder Junction.

citation.text: "Thunder Junction", section "Thunder". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tarkiri dragons and dragonstorms begin appearing on other planes through the Omenpaths.
timeline.quote: Tarkiri dragons began appearing on other planes.

citation.text: "Dragonstorm (phenomenon)", section "On other planes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The new dragonstorms render large areas uninhabitable and spawn uncontrolled dragons that can escape Tarkir through the Omenpaths.
timeline.quote: render large areas uninhabitable and spawn new, uncontrolled dragons

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cured of compleation, Jace and Vraska learn of the Omenpaths, distrust them and plot a rebirth of the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: They desired an end to the multiversal conflicts that had scarred them and plotted a rebirth of the Multiverse.

citation.work: Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse
citation.text: "Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Desparked planeswalkers are trapped on their current planes, while Omenpaths open across the Multiverse.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Planeswalkers that lost their sparks were subsequently trapped on their current plane.

citation.text: "Desparkening", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the invasion and the opening of the Omenpaths, Endrider gangs ride out of Gastal and run out of fuel.
timeline.quote: Endrider gangs rode their machines to freedom, leaving Gastal without a look in the rearview mirror

citation.text: "Endriders", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Stable Omenpaths suddenly appear, creating new channels of interplanar travel and beginning the Omenpath Era.
timeline.quote: the sudden appearance of stable Omenpaths created new channels of interplanar travel

citation.text: "Mending Era", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Talrand claims an Omenpath on Mistral Island as part of his territory.
timeline.quote: one was found on Mistral Island that Tarland claimed as part of his territory
